title: Lysogeny Broth (LB) Preparation Protocol
author: Haven Himmighoefer
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.ktbcwin

steps.title: Prepare LB Medium Components
steps.instruction: Combine reagents in a 1 L bottle with initial water and dissolve.

substeps.instruction: Fill a 1 L bottle to 500 mLs with water.
Add 10 g of tryptone, 10 g of sodium chloride, and 5 g of yeast extract.
Shake until all reagents are in solution.

steps.title: Adjust pH and Final Volume
steps.instruction: Balance the pH and bring the solution to the final volume.

substeps.instruction: Adjust pH to 7 using 5 N NaOH.
Fill the bottle with water to the 1 L mark.

steps.title: Sterilize via Autoclave
steps.instruction: Autoclave the medium using specific settings to prevent over-boiling.

substeps.instruction: Ensure there is water in the container to avoid over boiling.
